message.content: There is no mention of Li Hua planning to meet Yuriko Yamamoto to show the final website. The only interaction between Li Hua and Yuriko regarding the website is when Li Hua shares her initial impression of the demo website and receives feedback from Yuriko. Li Hua mentioned that they will work on adding a community outreach section to the website, and Yuriko suggested including details about the programs she offers and some testimonials and photos from past events. There is no indication of a specific meeting or location planned for the final presentation of the website.
